name: dev-preroll-hold
note: The 4 s expectation is `not the ad`, not `a dark cover`: after the worker-playlist route (2026-11-25) the clean picture is revealed at 830 ms, so the ad has no pixel on screen at 4/9/13/20 s while the native sits paused behind it (measured `blue=0.119`, `dark=0.402`). A full-screen black cover is not a goal here: the owner forbids black screens, and a cover would be a regression, not a pass. A preroll must be the FIRST program the player fetches: with `at:300` the page's first playlist was content, the ad block was stitched AFTER it, and the ad then played at media time 6-36s instead of 0-14s (measured 2026-11-25, no-extension control: black at 4/9/13s, ad-blue at 20s). The deterministic alternative is an ad-bearing playlist from the very first GET.
